What do you say to yourself when nobody is around?

Kevin Trudeau says rich people give themselves out loud pep talks. "I'm a winner. I'm going to make this happen." They don't say it in front of others. They say it to themselves.

He says most of us do the opposite and berate ourselves with our own words.

Which one sounds more like your inner voice?
